#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Normal+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Open
You: Damn it! This place is already packed and it’s hard to move…
Shanice: Wow, so you were telling the truth. There really is a hidden fashion show here! Who would have guessed…
You: I told you.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Yeah, sorry for doubting you. In my defense, in the end I didn’t push my panic button. That’s how much I trust you.
You: Thanks…
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.StaringIntoDistance+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Open
Shanice: But me being a model? Do you think it’s a good idea? It might be considered a sin…
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
You: You wanted to shoot at people a few minutes ago and you are concerned with this? Really?
Shanice: Well, I think I’m allowed one or two guilty pleasures, right? 
You: Please choose something different…
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
